name: Hothir
title: Levitical musician in the temple
summary: Hothir was one of the sons of Heman, who was one of the Levitical singers appointed by King David to serve in the temple. He was assigned the twenty-first lot for service with song and music in the house of the Lord. His name means 'abundance' or 'he who is rich'.

keyEvents.title: Appointed as a Temple Musician
keyEvents.description: Hothir was appointed as one of Heman's sons to serve with song and music in the house of the Lord, under the leadership of King David.

keyEvents.title: The Twenty-First Lot
keyEvents.description: Hothir received the twenty-first lot for the temple service order, and he led his group of sons and brothers, twelve in all.

keyEvents.title: Part of Heman's Fourteen Sons
keyEvents.description: Hothir is listed as one of Heman's fourteen sons, all given by God to exalt Him, according to God's promise.

keyEvents.title: Organization of Temple Service
keyEvents.description: King David organized the Levites into divisions for the musical service in the temple, where Hothir and his family received their assigned role.
